cases.case_label: Alu (PV/HS-1) in exon 7 of CASR at codon 877
cases.disease: Familial hypocalciuric hypercalcemia (heterozygous) / neonatal severe hyperparathyroidism (homozygous)
cases.mechanism_detail: Antisense Alu inserted at codon 877 in exon 7 introduces stop codons in all reading frames, predicting a truncated CaR lacking most of the C-terminal intracellular domain. FHH carriers are heterozygous and NSHPT patients homozygous.
cases.quote: Stop signals are introduced in all reading frames within the Alu sequence, leading to a predicted shortened mutant CaR protein.
